1. (Currently Amended) A cooling system installable within a structure wall, comprising: in a housing, the housing disposed between a pair of studs of the wall, a water reservoir; a pump; a pad; a water distributor; a motor; and a fan, wherein the cooling system is __specifically configured for installation between wall studs and operates by evaporative cooling__.

2. (Currently Amended) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the studs are spaced __approximately sixteen inches on center, with a tolerance of plus or minus two inches__.

3. (Original) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the studs are spaced about twenty-four inches on center.

4. (Currently Amended) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the pump brings water from the water reservoir to the water distributor and the water distributor distributes the water to the pad thereby moistening the pad, __and the cooling system is configured to operate within a wall cavity__.

5. (Currently Amended) The cooling system of claim 4, wherein the fan causes air to flow through the pad moistened by the water, thereby cooling the air by evaporation, __and the cooled air is directed into an interior space__.

6. (Currently Amended) The cooling system of claim 5, wherein the fan causes the cooled air to flow through __an opening in the housing__.

7. (Currently Amended) The cooling system of claim 4, wherein at least some of the water flows back to the reservoir for recirculation, __and the system is installed within the wall structure__.

8. (Original) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the water reservoir is filled with additional water when the water in the reservoir falls below a predetermined level.

9. (Original) The cooling system of claim 8, further including a ball float valve that opens to fill the water reservoir with the additional water when the water in the reservoir falls below the predetermined level.

10. (Original) The cooling system of claim 1, further including a water drain.

11. (Currently Amended) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the housing includes __a removable front cover__.

12. (Original) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the housing protrudes from the wall less than three inches.

13. (Currently Amended) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the wall is __a load-bearing wall of a structure__.

14. (Original) The cooling system of claim 1, wherein the structure is a garage.

15. (Currently Amended) A cooling system kit, comprising: the cooling system of claim 1; __mounting hardware including fasteners for securing the housing between wall studs__; and a ventilation grill.

16. (Original) The cooling system kit of claim 15, further including instructions.

17. (Currently Amended) A cooling system, comprising: __a housing configured for mounting within a structure wall between wall studs, the housing containing an evaporative cooling apparatus for cooling an indoor area__.

18. (Currently Amended) The cooling system of claim 17, wherein __the housing is positioned between wall studs spaced approximately sixteen inches on center, with a tolerance of plus or minus two inches__.

19. (Currently Amended) The cooling system of claim 17, wherein __the housing is configured for installation within a structure wall constructed using one of structural insulated panels (SIP) and insulating concrete forms (ICF)__.

20. (Cancelled)
